name: No King No Kingdom II
detailed_description:
No King No Kingdom II is an exciting first-person strategy in which you will feel like a real king. Rule villagers, collect resources, build your castle and gather a powerful army. Grab your sword, ride your favorite fantasy beast and lead your army to victory. Mysterious lands, magical artifacts, castle sieges and battles with powerful creatures await you.

Key Features


  • Classic RTS mechanics: direct unit control, resource gathering, army recruitment, and construction.
  • First-Person View gameplay - the player can personally take part in the battle using a sword (a bow is also planned in the development). In campaigns, you will find magical artifacts that will strengthen your troops or allow you to use attacking spells.
  • Mounts: To move quickly, you can mount such fantasy beasts as giant wolves, flying gryphons and even dragons.
  • Castle Sieges - when you siege castles, massive battles await you in which you can use catapults, battering rams, siege towers and other siege weapons.
  • Castle Development- Build your own castle in which each segment provides certain upgrades.
